quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging into your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging into your lane.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to road hazards. This sign warns you that traffic from the right will merge into your lane. Be ready to slow down and let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to road hazards. This sign warns you of a sharp turn ahead. Reduce your speed before entering the turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
Your road will cross a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road will cross a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road will cross a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guardrail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming. Watch for traffic from the side roads.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you an intersection is ahead. A road will join from the right side.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. The road splits in two directions. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to road hazards. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community group is picking up trash on the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road or driveway is not safe to enter from your direction. Turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead splits into a divided highway. Stay to the right of the median or divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead shows red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead shows green.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action shown is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is starting. The road splits into two separate one-way roads with a divider. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a lane for left turns only. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What should concern you most when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may be misaligned because one side of your car is higher.
You could damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
You could hydroplane if water is on the shoulder.
You could lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If a wheel drops off, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: Red is always on top and green on the bottom on a vertical traffic signal. On a horizontal signal, red is always on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. You may see several of these signs placed along a curve.

questions.question: From bottom to top, what is the order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: From bottom to top, traffic light colors are green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign means traffic flows only in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest legal speed you can drive on that road. In rain, snow, ice, or bad conditions, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign shows that a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. Drivers must stay on the side the arrow points to.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead turns sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is one-way and you must not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. HOV lanes are for buses and vehicles with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what must you do?

options.text: You may not exit the freeway.
You may continue through the interchange or exit from your current lane.
You may stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will not continue through the interchange. Instead, it will exit the freeway. You can change lanes to continue on the freeway, or you must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It shows laws that drivers must follow. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers are on the road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers of upcoming hazards. This sign means pedestrians may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers of upcoming hazards. This sign tells drivers that the right lane will end or the road will narrow ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are near.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or travel. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles are likely present on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals can be used instead of or along with turn signals. When a rider extends their left arm straight out, it means they are turning left or moving left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the entrance to one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in this direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It alerts drivers to upcoming hazards and road conditions. This sign means traffic may be coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding together. When the lead rider holds their left arm straight out with palm up, then swings their arm upward, it tells riders to increase their speed.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals show other drivers your plans. When you bend your left arm at the elbow and point upward, it means you plan to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right
Hiking trails ahead and to the right
Hotel ahead and to the right
Hospital ahead and to the right

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital emergency room is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction you must drive on a one-way street. You must follow the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you that a traffic light is coming. Be ready to stop at a red light or yield to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has several turns and curves.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly
May pass if you know the road ahead
May pass, but only at night

questions.explanation: This white rectangular sign is a rule you must obey. It means passing other vehicles is not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond sign warns you that wet pavement can be slippery. Drive carefully and reduce your speed so your vehicle stays under control.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic
Slow down without coming to a complete stop
Stop completely and wait for a green light
Slow down and check for traffic

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop and look for pedestrians and traffic before entering the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming. Prepare to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low railroad crossing. The road slopes steeply down to the tracks. Low-clearance vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange. They warn you of work ahead. Slow down and drive carefully through construction zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is extended straight out to the left, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals when turn signals are not available. A left arm extended straight out means the rider plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, but you may not always need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always come to a complete stop. Then go only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is coming from both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves right and then left. You should slow down to safely handle these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not pass if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles pass first. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down and swings it down to their side, it tells the group to slow down.

questions.question: What does this green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: This sign warns you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road ahead has many curves. You should slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: In group riding, what does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, the group should stop.

questions.question: What does this signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding in groups. This signal means 'follow me.'

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (for example, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs tell drivers to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a roundabout is ahead. Enter slowly and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: This sign shape and color is a _____________ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign means the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and yield the right-of-way at the intersection. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits only
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow
These lanes are for buses and vehicles with a driver and at least one passenger

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits only
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it means the rider:
questions.explanation: Riders can use hand signals instead of turn signals. When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that parking is not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that an upcoming bridge may be too narrow to pass a truck. You should slow down and be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that when turning left at a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you to watch for bicycles crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about an upcoming winding road with multiple curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means that the action shown is not allowed. Right turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you to an upcoming intersection.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign do?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background. They warn you about road conditions and hazards ahead.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead. Always slow down when approaching railroad tracks. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for the train to pass before crossing.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign (in this case, 35 mph).

questions.question: The posted speed limit shows:

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road when conditions are perfect. You may need to drive slower if conditions are bad. Always drive slower when weather or road conditions are poor.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane will end soon. Prepare to move to another lane.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means the action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming up. Be prepared to stop and watch for traffic from all directions.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When you hold your left arm bent at the elbow and point it down, it means you are slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it rains or is wet. Slow down and be extra careful.

questions.question: This sign is used to warn drivers:

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending. Drivers in the right lane must move to the left lane.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is a regulation sign that tells you what you can and cannot do. It means you are not allowed to turn left at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that right turns are not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You may turn right or go straight.
You may turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you must either turn right or go straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes are about to become one lane. Be ready to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to drive in the right lane to avoid an upcoming hazard.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always yield to pedestrians in a crosswalk. Stay alert for children near schools and intersections.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross this road. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow and black sign warns you that there is not enough space for tall vehicles ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that pedestrians may cross the road ahead. Drive carefully and watch for people crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black sign warns that a lane is ending ahead. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Look and listen for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may enter from a side road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means a steep hill is coming. Slow down to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to road hazards ahead. This sign warns of a steep downhill. Slow down to avoid brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let other traffic go first before you enter the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to road hazards ahead. This sign warns you to be careful when the road is wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: On the freeway, you see a "Merging traffic" sign. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your current speed.
Speed up to avoid traffic jams.
Move to another lane, if it is safe, to make room.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if it is safe, to make room.
questions.explanation: When a lane is merging, move to another lane if it is safe. This makes room for traffic entering the roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves to the right, then to the left.
The road ahead curves to the left, then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves to the right, then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road curves right and then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reduce your speed when the road is wet.
The road ahead has a series of curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or turns, and increase your distance from other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that a school zone is approaching. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must obey. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on the upcoming hill.
Trucks are on the upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and points one finger?

options.text: The group will exit at the next exit.

questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider raises their left arm and extends one finger, it tells the group to form a single-file line.
